releaseNotes: Smart Lookup now detects real table headers even when sheets contain report titles, dates or grouped headings above the data.
Column selectors now use actual Excel field names and column letters, making it easier to match items and choose values to update.
Smart Lookup can recommend multiple identifying columns when one field alone contains duplicates.
Value selection now automatically suggests matching destination columns and shows where changed values exist.
Improved external workbook reading to avoid unnecessary workbook-window flashing during source analysis.
